title: An Empirical Study of Group Conformity in Multi-Agent Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on social psychology phenomena such as group conformity and bias propagation within multi-agent LLM systems. While it uses socially contentious topics with ethical dimensions (like the death penalty) as experimental variables, its primary research goal is to observe the dynamics of influence and opinion formation rather than to evaluate or benchmark the models' adherence to specific moral, religious, or ethical frameworks.
